To import existing workbook history, run  python -m models.hv.session.migrate_excel_to_mongodb  on each workstation that has local logs. The migration is repeatable for the same workbook rows.

% This isn’t failing at the password check: DNS resolves and TCP port 27017 is reachable, but the TLS handshake fails on every Atlas shard. I also saw the failure with both TLS 1.2 and 1.3, which points to the network path or Atlas endpoint—not a simple username/password typo.

% Try connecting from a mobile hotspot or another network, with VPN/proxy temporarily off. If it works there, ask your network administrator to check outbound MongoDB TLS traffic on TCP 27017 and whether TLS inspection is interfering. In Atlas, also confirm the cluster is running and your current public egress IP is in Network Access → IP Access List;  10.0.42.86  is your local address, not the public IP Atlas needs. Use the connection string copied from that cluster’s Connect → Drivers page.

% Don’t disable TLS certificate verification; that would weaken the connection and won’t fix a handshake alert. My terminal didn’t have  MONGODB_URI  set, so I couldn’t retry the full application ping here, but the direct TLS checks reproduced the handshake failure.

% good this is working now, i need login and logout session data also to be stored, and all the data to be in sync everytime, and the app will be running slow (especially the battery pak dummy id gui), so have a look on this too.

Implemented the sync and session changes. Login/logout events now go to Atlas’s  login_sessions  collection with username, role, workstation, and UTC timestamps—never the password. Scan History checks Atlas every five seconds for updates from other workstations, and Export Excel creates a current Atlas-wide workbook without overwriting existing local workbooks. Dummy ID serials are now reserved atomically, preventing two workstations from printing the same generated serial.

The Battery Pack Dummy ID no longer performs MongoDB reads or writes during rapid configuration/date updates, which should reduce UI pauses. I also removed the exposed URI credentials from  db.md  and generated bytecode. Rotate the Atlas password now—it was exposed in chat—and update  MONGODB_URI  on each workstation with the replacement.
